abstract: A 15-year-old male was admitted to our hospital for treatment of an anterior mediastinal tumor. The tumor was visualized by chest radiography 3 months prior to admission. Computed tomography (CT) revealed a heterogeneous solid tumor located in the anterior mediastinum. Although CT-guided needle biopsy had been performed twice, histologic diagnosis could not be confirmed. We believed this tumor to be nonseminomatous mediastinal germ cell tumor (NSGCT) and started intensive chemotherapy with cisplatin (CDDP) without histologic diagnosis because his serum AFP level was rapidly increasing. After 2 courses of chemotherapy, his serum AFP level returned to the normal range and surgical resection of the tumor with part of right lung was performed. Histopathological examination revealed that the tumor consisted of mature teratoma and yolk sac tumor. He underwent 1 course of chemotherapy post-operatively because a small number of viable cells were histopathologically recognized in the yolk sac component. At the time of writing, the patient is alive without any evidence of recurrence.
abstract_ja: 15歳の男性が前縦隔腫瘍の治療目的で当院を受診した。腫瘍は3か月前の胸部X線検査で認められていた。CTで前縦隔に不均一な充実性腫瘍を認めた。CTガイド下針生検を2回施行したが、組織診断は確定しなかった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)と考え、血清AFP値が急速に上昇していたため、組織診断なしでシスプラチン(CDDP)による集中的化学療法を開始した。化学療法2コース後に血清AFP値は正常範囲に戻り、右肺の一部を含む腫瘍の外科的切除を施行した。病理組織学的検査で、腫瘍は成熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍から成ることが判明した。卵黄嚢成分に少数の生存細胞が認められたため、術後に化学療法を1コース追加した。執筆時点で患者は再発の所見なく生存している。
